question: How does the impact of increasing the number of retrieved documents on QA performance differ between GPT-3.5-Turbo and RAG models?
answer: For RAG models, retrieving more documents at test time monotonically improves open-domain QA results for RAG-Sequence, while performance for RAG-Token peaks at 10 retrieved documents [1]. In contrast, for GPT-3.5-Turbo, reader model performance saturates long before retriever performance, and using more than 20 retrieved documents only marginally improves its performance (by ~1.5%) while significantly increasing input context length, latency, and cost [3]. Furthermore, GPT-3.5-Turbo's multi-document QA performance can drop by more than 20%, where performance in 20- and 30-document settings can even be lower than closed-book performance without any input documents [2].
